artifacts.title: BCO 7 qualifications limited to biological men who hold office

matches.evidence: The CCB found that an overture amending BCO 7 regarding the requirement that church officers be men is not in conflict with the BCO.

artifacts.title: Codifying biblical sexuality standard for church officers in BCO 7

matches.evidence: The CCB found that amending BCO 7 to codify the biblical standard for church officers related to human sexuality is not in conflict with the BCO.

artifacts.title: Officers' self-identification by biblical sins barred in BCO 7

matches.evidence: The CCB found that amending BCO 7 to prohibit church officers from self-describing by biblical sins (e.g., 'gay Christian') is not in conflict with the BCO.

artifacts.title: Disqualifying from office men who identify as homosexual
artifacts.disposition: not in conflict; Adopted by the CCB

matches.evidence: CCB found no constitutional conflict in an overture to amend BCO 7 disqualifying from ordained office men who identify as homosexual.

artifacts.title: Disqualifying same-sex attracted men from ordination under BCO 7

matches.evidence: An overture from Westminster Presbytery to amend BCO 7 and related provisions disqualifying same-sex attracted men from ordination was found in conflict and adopted.
